note: iOS tests run via the iOS Simulator + ai-computer-use. The simulator is a macOS window that ai-computer-use can see and interact with.

ui_context.layout: NavigationStack with List. Top stats section shows contact count and favorites count. All Contacts section with rows showing name, email, star icon. Toolbar + button for adding. Search bar at top.
tips: This is an iOS app in the Simulator window
Tap contact rows to see detail with Full Name
Swipe left on a row to reveal Delete
The search bar is at the top of the list — pull down to reveal it if hidden

scenarios.name: full_name_order_correct
steps: The ContactsApp should be visible in the Simulator
Tap on the first contact row (Alice Smith) to open the detail view
assertions: The detail view shows the full name as 'Alice Smith' (first name before last name, not 'Smith Alice')

scenarios.name: add_contact_sorted
scenarios.description: Clean: New contacts are sorted alphabetically
steps: The ContactsApp should be visible in the Simulator
Tap the + button in the top-right toolbar to add a new contact
Enter 'Aaron' as the first name
Enter 'Adams' as the last name
Enter 'aaron@example.com' as the email
Tap Save to save the new contact
assertions: Back on the main list, 'Aaron Adams' appears at or near the top of the contact list (sorted alphabetically before Alice)

scenarios.name: delete_correct_contact
scenarios.description: Clean: Swipe-to-delete removes the correct contact
steps: The ContactsApp should be visible in the Simulator
Note the name of the first contact in the list (it should be Alice Smith)
Swipe left on the first contact row to reveal the Delete action, then tap Delete
assertions: Alice Smith is no longer in the contact list (the first contact has been removed)

scenarios.name: search_finds_lastname
scenarios.description: Clean: Search matches first name, last name, and email
steps: The ContactsApp should be visible in the Simulator
Tap the search bar at the top of the list (pull down to reveal if needed)
Type 'Smith' into the search field
assertions: Alice Smith appears in the filtered search results (searching by last name works)

scenarios.name: favorite_count_correct
scenarios.description: Clean: Favorite count shows the actual number of favorites
steps: The ContactsApp should be visible in the Simulator
Look at the stats section at the top of the list
assertions: The favorites count displays '2 favorites' (Alice and Carol are pre-set as favorites, not 0)
